As parents ourselves, we look for family-friendly homes near great things to do, where kids can have fun and parents can finally relax.

about.title: Modern Comfort. Scenic Retreats. Hosts Who Care.
story: We met in Georgia almost 15 years ago, and in January 2027 we'll celebrate 10 years of marriage. Our daughter Emmeline (Emmy) arrived in 2019 and our son Leo in 2022, and travel has been part of our family's life from the very start.

That love of travel is what brought us into vacation rentals. We bought our first cabin, Cherry Log Summit in the North Georgia mountains, in 2021, followed by Havana Haven in Fort Lauderdale in 2022. Since then, BK Stays has grown into a property management and co-hosting business caring for 14 homes across Georgia, Florida, Michigan and Minnesota, and we've loved connecting with owners, fellow hosts and travelers looking for their next great getaway.

Brandon spent more than a decade working in college football before moving into vacation rentals full time. Katharina grew up in Germany, moved to the States in 2013 and has spent over a decade in consulting and recruiting for German companies. Working remotely means we get to travel with our kids, stay in our own homes and keep exploring new places. Right now we're living abroad, discovering new countries and cities while Emmy and Leo are enrolled in a world school program.

Traveling as parents of young kids shapes every home we host. We look for family-friendly places close to great things to do, where kids can have a blast while parents finally sit back and relax, and we care for each one the way we'd want our own family's stay to feel.

favorites.title: Cherry Log Summit
favorites.text: Leo's happy place is the cabin. At Cherry Log Summit he can run around outside, get muddy, climb the playground and just be a boy out in nature, while mom and dad enjoy the jacuzzi and the mountain views. With a fully fenced-in yard and a game room for rainy days, it's our top pick for families traveling with kids.

favorites.title: Havana Haven
favorites.text: Emmy calls it "the Orange House," and it's her favorite place to visit, hands down. She'll never pass up a trip with a pool and a beach, and Havana Haven has both: a large heated pool in the backyard and the Fort Lauderdale beaches only a mile away.

meet: Brandon and Katharina's journey began over 10 years ago in Atlanta, where they met and quickly became partners in life and business. After a destination wedding in Mexico, their family grew with their daughter, Emmy, and son, Leo, plus three rescue dogs.

Brandon, originally from Iowa, has a deep background in sports and has worked in college athletics since moving to Atlanta. Katharina, a dual citizen born and raised in Germany, is the Director of the German Desk for an international recruiting and consulting firm. Together, they've built a property management business grounded in family values and exceptional service.
